match_area_estimate: This match uses an approximate town or village location. Confirm the exact pickup and delivery places by call or chat.
match_address_estimate: The PIN codes and named areas match the trip's start and destination. Map distance is unavailable. Confirm the exact pickup, village and delivery time by call or chat.
address_village_hint: Enter the actual town or village in City / town / village, and its neighbourhood in Village / locality. Use the correct PIN code. House numbers and landmarks belong in the address lines.
match_town_estimate: The town/village and PIN codes match, but the neighbourhoods differ. Confirm pickup and delivery points with the partner before agreeing. Distance is not verified.
match_pickup_area: No trip start matches the shop's pickup town/village and PIN code. Check the shop address and trip start.
match_destination_area: No trip destination matches the delivery town/village and PIN code. Check both addresses.
match_accept_quote: Accept the shop's quote before looking for a delivery partner.
match_shop_location: The shop's pickup location could not be confirmed. Ask the seller to check the shop address or use current location.
match_delivery_location: The delivery location could not be confirmed. Check the delivery address with the seller before proceeding.
match_trip_location: The trip's route could not be confirmed. The partner needs to check the start and destination addresses.
match_no_upcoming: No eligible upcoming trips are available. The buyer and seller cannot deliver their own order.
match_category: The available trips do not support this parcel category.
match_direction: The available trips do not pass pickup before delivery in the required direction.
match_route_proximity: The saved pickup or delivery location is outside the available routes. Check the addresses and location accuracy.
match_pickup_window: The trip's pickup time is outside the quote's pickup window. Ask the seller to update the times and accept the revised quote.
match_delivery_window: The trip arrives after the delivery deadline. Ask the seller to update the deadline and accept the revised quote.
match_window_expired: The quote's delivery window has ended. Ask the seller for an updated quote.
match_preparation: The food preparation time does not fit this trip. Ask the seller to update the schedule.
match_invalid_schedule: The saved trip or quote schedule is incomplete. Check its dates and times.
match_configuration: Route matching is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
trip_edit_locked: A buyer has confirmed delivery on this trip. Its details can no longer be changed.
trip_departed: This trip has already started and cannot be edited.
trip_edit_unavailable: Editing is closed after departure or a buyer confirms delivery.
trip_updated: The delivery partner changed the trip. Please choose a trip and agree on delivery again.
search_keywords: Search keywords in Hindi and English, separated by commas
invalid_input: Check your entries and try again.
invalid_credentials: The mobile number or password did not match. Check both and try again.
too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
readiness_required: Your delivery partner must confirm readiness before food preparation can start.
quote_expired: This quote has expired. Ask the shop to send a fresh quote.
invalid_otp: The code did not match. Check the latest code and try again.
otp_expired: The code has expired. Request a new code.
invalid_image: Choose a valid JPG, PNG, or WebP image under 5 MB.
file_too_large: This image is too large. Choose an image under 5 MB.
partner_not_approved: Your delivery application needs approval. Check your profile for its status.
utc_note: Times are shown in India time (Asia/Kolkata).
quote_revised: Quote revised; review the new terms
wrong_code: The code did not match. Check it and try again.
code_locked: Too many incorrect codes. Ask for help with this delivery.
quote_version_changed: The quote has changed. Review the latest version.
no_capacity: This trip has no space left. Choose another trip.
own_shop_notice: This is your shop. To change its details, go to Profile → My shop.
items_en: Example items in English, separated by commas
items_hi: Matching example items in Hindi, separated by commas
phone_signin: Sign in with a phone code
firebase_not_configured: Phone verification is not configured yet. The owner must add the Firebase settings.
link_password: Existing account password (only needed to link your account)
firebase_consent: I agree to receive a verification SMS. Google processes my phone number for authentication and spam prevention.
firebase_sms_error: Firebase could not complete phone verification. Share the error reference below with support.
firebase_billing_error: Google has not enabled SMS billing for this Firebase project. The owner must check that the project is linked to an active billing account; selecting Blaze alone may not finish activation.
firebase_domain_error: Phone sign-in is not authorized on this website. Open the approved HTTPS site or ask the owner to authorize this domain in Firebase.
firebase_captcha_error: Firebase rejected the app verification. Request a fresh challenge on the approved HTTPS site. If it continues, the owner must check the authorized domain and Firebase app settings.
firebase_rate_error: Firebase has temporarily limited requests. Wait before trying again; repeatedly sending codes can extend the block.
firebase_quota_error: This project's SMS quota has been reached. The owner must check Firebase usage and quotas before trying again.
firebase_network_error: Could not reach Firebase. Check your connection and whether your browser blocks Google's authentication or reCAPTCHA requests.
firebase_provider_error: Phone sign-in is disabled or not permitted for this project. The owner must check the Phone provider and SMS region policy in Firebase.
firebase_app_error: Firebase rejected this app's configuration. The owner must check the web API key, its restrictions, and the Firebase project settings.
firebase_phone_error: Enter a valid Indian mobile number with 10 digits, without +91.
firebase_localhost_notice: Local testing: real SMS sign-in requires an authorized HTTPS website. Use a Firebase fictional test number here, or open the hosted test site.
firebase_code_sent: Code requested. Enter the SMS code, or the configured code if you are using a Firebase test number.
firebase_invalid_token: Verification failed. Request a new code and sign in again.
firebase_reauthenticate: Your verification expired. Request a fresh code.
firebase_link_password: Enter your existing account password to securely link this phone sign-in.
firebase_profile_required: This is a new account. Use Create account to enter your name and password.
delivery_success_note: Delivery is confirmed. Check your parcel and review the order before settling or reporting a problem.
on_way_note: Your delivery partner has collected the parcel and is on the way. Keep your delivery code ready.
ready_note: The shop has packed your parcel. It is ready for your delivery partner to collect.
problem_note: This order needs attention. Read the latest activity and the available next step below.
progress_note: Follow the highlighted step below. Each participant sees the latest confirmed update.
address_check: Check your address and edit it if it is wrong
location_failed: Could not find your location. Enter the address manually.
location_denied: Location permission was denied. You can enter the address manually.
location_manual: Your location was captured. Please fill and check the address manually.
location_unverified: This trip can be matched using its saved addresses. Confirm the exact pickup and delivery points by call or chat.
discuss_pickup: Confirm available space, parcel size and pickup time by call or chat.
pickup_from_shop: Pickup uses the address saved in your shop profile.
camera_switch_failed: Could not switch camera. Your current camera is still selected.
audio_output_failed: Could not change the audio output.
audio_output_unsupported: Use your device’s volume and audio controls. This browser cannot choose the speaker.
notification_explanation: Enable notifications to hear about messages, order updates and incoming calls on this device. You can choose the categories below.
notification_denied: Notifications are blocked. You can allow them in your browser’s site settings.
push_unconfigured: Push notifications are not configured yet. Updates remain available here.
push_unsupported: This browser does not support web push. On iPhone, add this app to the Home Screen first.
no_notifications: You are all caught up. New updates will appear here.
staff_reauth_hint: For sensitive actions such as bans and approvals, sign out and sign in again first. Every decision is recorded.
decision_no_money: This records a final decision and a pending settlement instruction. No money will move. Check the amounts carefully; the decision cannot be edited.
full_release: Full release of agreed goods and delivery amounts
case_closed: Case closed. Payment instruction remains pending.
response_window_open: Wait for all other parties to respond or for the response deadline.
dispute_window_closed: The reporting window for this delivery has ended.
case_taken: Another reviewer has already taken this case. Refresh the queue.
resolver_conflict: You cannot review a case in which you are involved.
invalid_settlement: Check the allocations. Use whole paise within the agreed goods and delivery totals.
unaffected_delivery_protected: This dispute does not cover delivery. Keep the agreed delivery allocation.
unaffected_goods_protected: This dispute does not cover goods. Keep the agreed goods allocation.
already_settled: A decision has already been recorded. Refresh to view it.
invalid_address: Complete the address fields and try again.
account_banned: This account is restricted. Please contact support.
staff_marketplace_forbidden: Use your staff panel for this account. Marketplace actions require a separate account.
invalid_evidence: Choose up to five valid evidence images for this order.
session_expired: Your sign-in session changed or expired. Refresh this page and sign in again. If this repeats, allow cookies for this site.
shops_sub: Explore approved local shops. Choose a town to narrow the list.
